description: Deploy an app. Fetches the repo and checks for run-zero.yaml (or the older itdone.yaml). If found, syncs all services + addons + domains from config. If not, deploys the repo as a single service. Services missing from the config are scaled to 0; with prune=true they are DELETED. Run runzero_deploy_preview first to see the diff. Read `warnings` in the result: it reports data that will not survive a restart (a known image without room for its automatic volume, SQLite in the code without `volumes:`) and gives the exact fix. Apply it before you call the app done.

prune.description: Delete services not present in config (default: false → scale to 0 instead)

name: runzero_deploy
title: Deploy app
